name: The Modern Atlas
storyline:
Frankenstein. A name that has become synonymous with a terrifying legend. A young medical student whose ambition led to his own destruction and the deaths of those he loved. Every one is gone, and the world is left with only speculation, the fading echoes of gossip... Or not?

Ernest Frankenstein is forced to accept his fate. The past cannot be changed, the dead cannot return, and there is no one to avenge. As the young man began to find peace in his new life, fate condemned him once again to endure change...

Solve the mystery of the new murders and find out the truth. May justice prevail!
summary: This is an in-progress visual novel from the perspective of Ernest Frankenstein, Victor's younger brother, taking place after the events of Mary Shelley's novel.
